stories.title: Djokovic Wins 7th Beijing Title, 102nd Career Crown — De Minaur Retires

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
DJOKOVIC WINS BEIJING. Beats de Minaur 7-6(3), 1-0 ret. as de Minaur retires with a groin injury.

No. 7 Beijing title. No. 102 career title. At 39, the oldest ATP 500 champion in the Open Era. 34-0 all-time.

#ATP #ChinaOpen #Djokovic

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
34-0 in Beijing. 102 career titles. Oldest ATP 500 champion ever.

Novak Djokovic's 7th China Open title came a day after Medvedev was defaulted for hitting a spectator. Wild two days in Beijing.

#Djokovic #ChinaOpen #ATP
x_posts.tweet_type: FOLLOW-UP (Oct 6 S2: Beijing SFs → Final result)

facebook.image_caption: 7-0, 7-0, 7 titles. Djokovic in Beijing is simply untouchable. 🎾 His 102nd career title and 34-0 record at the China Open says everything.

article.headline: Djokovic Wins 7th Beijing Title and 102nd Career Crown as De Minaur Retires

x_posts.text:
UPSET ALERT: Elise Mertens def. No. 3 seed Coco Gauff 6-3, 6-3 in WTA Beijing R16 — Mertens' FIRST win over Gauff in six career meetings.

Defending champion Gauff is out. No top-3 seed remains. #WTA #ChinaOpen

Iga Swiatek's R16 win at WTA Beijing was her 148th WTA 1000 main-draw win — TYING Serena Williams' all-time record.

One more win vs. Mertens in the QF (Oct 9) and Swiatek owns it outright. #Swiatek #WTA #ChinaOpen
